pages.title: Splitter Ports
pages.text: A splitter accepts items on one horizontal face and sends them to the other three horizontal faces.$(br2)When placed, its input faces you. Connect a supply belt to that face and destination belts to the outputs.

pages.title: Distribution
pages.text: The splitter rotates through outputs that can accept an item. Full or disconnected outputs are skipped.$(br2)Click the specific output face with a belt to start an outgoing section. Complete an incoming belt on the input face.$(br2)Outputs share the incoming supply.
